items.text: Blue Jays trade Pat Hentgen and Paul Spoljaric to the Cardinals for Alberto Castillo, Matt DeWitt and Lance Painter
Yankees trade cash and Charlie Hayes to the Giants for Alberto Castillo and Chris Singleton
Wade Boggs becomes a free agent (Yankees)
Jack Morris becomes a free agent (Twins)
Dodgers trade cash, Vito Tamulis, Bill Crouch and Mickey Livingston to the Phillies for Kirby Higbe
Rick Ferrell signs with the Browns
Giants trade cash, Jim Donnelly and Ducky Holmes to the Cardinals for Mike Grady and Fred Hartman
Orioles trade Steve Brodie and Jim Donnelly to the Pirates for Jake Stenzel, Tom O'Brien, Harry Truby and Elmer Horton

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
